announcements.title: What's New in v1.4.0
bullets: Send to Gemini Notebook — push your selected videos straight into a notebook as sources, without leaving the dashboard
Download transcripts in bulk — select any number of videos and get a text file per video, named after the video and timestamped line by line
TidyWL checks which videos actually have captions first, and tells you exactly which ones it couldn't get and why
Exclude videos by topic — hide whole topics from the list instead of filtering down to one
Sort by views, and see which version of TidyWL you're running in the dashboard header

announcements.title: YouTube Watch Later Tidy v1.4.0 is live — force-update if you don't have it yet
bullets: Open a new tab and go to chrome://extensions
Top-right corner: turn on Developer mode
Reload your YouTube tab — you should now be on v1.4.0 (the version is shown under the dashboard title)
